I recently completed my PhD in mathematics at the University of Utah, where I developed stochastic models of biological systems under the supervision of [Sean Lawley](https://www.math.utah.edu/~lawley/). 

Prior to my PhD, I conducted research in bioinformatics and computational genomics. 

More broadly, I’m interested in applying mathematical and computational approaches across different areas of science.
